Definition: from Μοῦσα (a Muse); "musical", i.e. (as noun) a minstrel:--musician.
BiblicalUsage: Mousikos is a musician — in fallen Babylon the voice of harpers and musicians and pipers and trumpeters shall be heard no more at all in her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the silence is part of the judgment: when a city that lived for pleasure falls, the music is the first thing to stop.
